text.text_excerpt: This place is great! Especially for people that work in the building! It's a coffee shop that also serves hot breakfast and lunch. They have fresh pastries, cookies, and really good cinnamon rolls. Their mushroom and Brie soup is amazing! Probably my favorite thing I've had so far. They have a different soup daily- chicken enchilada, baked potato, etc. I haven't had the coffee but heard it's good and it's reasonably priced. The sandwiches all get good reviews from others as well. I enjoyed the ham and cheese on croissant. A good option on Napoleon if you work or live close to Ochsner Baptist!

WARNING!!!!! This place is across the street from Oschner baptist just about. So there will be nurses, doctors, patients, etc in here so please don't yall about the wait time for food! I ordered a pizza with ham,bacon (the best bacon all crunchy and crispy) pepperoni and sausage. This pizza was pretty good. A nice personal size pizza for myself and very fulfilling might I add. The sauce was good and my toppings were just how I like it. I have eaten here before and I had a good meal even then. There's also the meal of the day. JUST OPENED IN THE "TOWER" I'd estimate that 67% of all responsible adults in New Orleans have at least one physician in that lone medical mid-rise across from the old Baptist's. Heck I have three, and as I get older I'm sure that I'll be slinging my aging carcass all-up-in-there weekly. MOM & POP Recently, natives Kelly, Kyle and parents moved their family coffee shop from Fulton St. (the only decent cafe in that area) to this more appropriate location. The vibe here is so old-school that I defy anyone to approach these vivacious 20-ish entrepreneurs and not walk away enthused (especially uplifting after a colonoscopy and that horrible 36 hour fast!)
